title: The Flows page shows a flow as on when the Supervisor has it on, and counts the drafts waiting for the Owner
description: GET /v1/flows/{key} reads enabled from the shipped stream.json, which is always false, so the Flows page says the live flow is off even while the Supervisor runs it. It reads awaiting_owner_total from a state.json counter nothing writes, so it says 0 while drafts wait. The Owner's on/off switch lives in settings('supervisor') and the drafts live in $FW_HOME/flows/<key>/drafts/. Make GET /v1/flows/{key} answer enabled from the Supervisor's switch for that flow (false when it has never been turned on), and, for a flow that keeps cycle drafts, awaiting_owner_total as the number of drafts whose status is waiting_for_owner. Rejected and handed-off drafts do not count. Turning the flow off answers enabled false again.
acceptance: A fresh fwd answers enabled false and awaiting_owner_total 0 for neighborhood-activation
After POST /v1/supervisor/flows/neighborhood-activation/enable, GET /v1/flows/neighborhood-activation answers enabled true and agrees with GET /v1/supervisor
awaiting_owner_total equals the number of drafts waiting for the Owner; rejected and handed-off drafts are not counted
After disable, enabled is false again
